decisions.reason: The PETG thermoforming blank is a staple consumable in the firm's core dental-lab business, so it likely meets aspirations even though it was not observed on the website in 2020 to 2021.
The UV-curing lacquer had low visibility and was not observed in 2020 to 2021, which raises the risk it falls short of aspiration, but it is cheap to carry with the slack of a large firm.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the strategic push into digital scanning workflows, which justifies continued tolerance despite the missing evidence after 2019.

Custom earmolds belong to the established custom-device base for hearing-care retailers, so dropping them would not free much for problemistic search, even after the 2019 pruning of hearing protection.
